name: Gaussian Parameterization and Initialization
definition: Decomposes the model output parameters $G_{ij}$ for Gaussians into components $(G_{rgb}, G_{scale}, G_{rotation}, G_{opacity}, G_{distance})$ to facilitate training stability and correct interpretation of raw outputs.
summary: Gaussian Parameterization and Initialization decodes transformer tokens into valid 3D Gaussian attributes using specific biases and normalization, distinguishing itself by decoupling color into zero-order spherical harmonics and using distance-based ray parameterization for positions.
